records.key: Open the next image in the queue.
records.source: Open the next image in the queue.

records.key: Open the previous image in the queue.
records.source: Open the previous image in the queue.

records.key: Discard this draft and keep previously applied annotations unchanged.
records.source: Discard this draft and keep previously applied annotations unchanged.
records.translation: Kassera detta utkast och behåll tidigare tillämpade annoteringar oförändrade.

records.key: Return from an image to its well, and from a well to the plate.
records.source: Return from an image to its well, and from a well to the plate.
records.translation: Gå tillbaka från en bild till dess brunn och från en brunn till plattan.

records.key: Go back one step or one well.
records.source: Go back one step or one well.
records.translation: Gå tillbaka ett steg eller en brunn.

records.key: Go on to the next step or well.
records.source: Go on to the next step or well.
records.translation: Gå vidare till nästa steg eller brunn.

records.key: Place this well on the next page.
records.source: Place this well on the next page.
records.translation: Placera denna brunn på nästa sida.

records.key: Place this well on the previous page.
records.source: Place this well on the previous page.
records.translation: Placera denna brunn på föregående sida.
